bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to early childhood; providing funding for Head Start; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HEAD START PROGRAM. +]

[+$15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the Head Start program under Minnesota Statutes, section 142D.12. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to early childhood; providing funding for Head Start; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HEAD START PROGRAM.

$15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the Head Start program under Minnesota Statutes, section 142D.12.
additions: $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the Head Start program under Minnesota Statutes, section 142D.12.
